name: Header
summary: Sticky site masthead with required brand destination, optional primary navigation, canonical Button or Link actions, cart-count badge, and container-responsive mobile-trigger composition.

anatomy.name: action
anatomy.description: Positioning hook applied to a composed canonical Button or native Link action.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Default responsive header height and spacing.

states.name: navHover
states.description: Navigation-link hover keeps primary text contrast and exposes the accent underline.

states.name: focusVisible
states.description: Keyboard focus on brand and navigation links remains distinct.

states.name: currentPage
states.description: Current destination keeps primary text contrast and exposes the accent underline.

states.name: compactNav
states.description: Below the existing 48rem Header-container threshold, primary navigation is hidden and the optional mobile trigger remains available.

states.name: expandedNav
states.description: At or above the existing 48rem Header-container threshold, primary navigation is available and the mobile trigger is hidden.

behavior.name: mastheadSemantics
behavior.description: A top-level Header element supplies the page banner landmark natively; nested previews do not add a banner role.

behavior.name: primaryNavigation
behavior.description: Primary navigation should expose a labelled navigation region and current-page state.

behavior.name: containerResponse
behavior.description: The existing 48rem composition threshold is evaluated against Header inline size; unsupported container-query targets retain the compact mobile-trigger fallback.

behavior.name: canonicalActions
behavior.description: Actions compose canonical Button or native Link implementations; Header owns only grouping and badge positioning.

behavior.name: mobileMenuTrigger
behavior.description: When connected, the mobile trigger must control a Mobile Menu or Drawer adapter and synchronize expanded state.

behavior.name: cartCount
behavior.description: The visible badge is subordinate to the cart action accessible name; target cart state owns updates and live-region policy.

behavior.name: targetServices
behavior.description: Search, account, cart, mobile navigation, mega-menu coordination, action priority, route dismissal, focus, scroll offset, and global state remain target-owned.

properties.name: logo
properties.description: Brand name or brand image rendered by the logo link.

properties.name: logoHref
properties.description: Brand-home destination for the logo link.

properties.name: logoLabel
properties.description: Accessible name only when visible brand text or image alternative does not already identify the home link.

properties.name: navigationLabel
properties.description: Accessible name for the optional primary navigation region.

properties.name: navigation
properties.description: Target-owned primary navigation links and current-page markup.

properties.name: actions
properties.description: Canonical Button and native Link dependencies for target-owned global actions; each may add the Header positioning hook.

properties.name: cartCount
properties.description: Target-formatted visible cart count mirrored in the composed cart action's accessible name.

properties.name: mobileMenuTrigger
properties.description: Optional Button dependency that a target may connect to Mobile Menu or Drawer behavior.

accessibility: Use a top-level header element for the page banner and do not add redundant role="banner".
Use a labelled nav region for the primary navigation.
Expose current destination with aria-current when possible.
Compose actions from canonical Button or native Link implementations with visible focus and accessible names.
Include cart quantity in the cart action accessible name and apply live-region policy in target cart state.
Connected mobile menu triggers need synchronized aria-expanded and aria-controls.
Sticky page shells must keep focused and fragment-linked content visible below the occupied Header.

web.notes: Canonical CSS owns sticky/container-responsive composition; the page shell owns action and overlay services.

shopify.notes: Liquid maps brand, menu, actions, and cart data, but shared search/cart/mobile runtime and action priority remain target work.
